title: Causal phase-factorized relational encoders with weak change-point supervision
coverage_gap: The LL/HH-only support conflates lateral object approach with lateral goal transport. It also contains a sharp reversal from descent to lift, followed by forward carry and sometimes descent after crossing. A single unstructured condition can mix those modes when x factors are recombined.
reusable_regularity: Grasping depends chiefly on hand/object coupling, whereas transport depends on the independent goal and obstacle. Four learned feature branches specialize in approach, lift, transport and settling; a learned causal router softly weights them. The approach branch has no goal inputs. The router has no absolute object_x or goal_x input, so correlated layout signs cannot directly become phase identifiers. Router supervision is a weak training-only proxy extracted from demonstrated action change points, not a supplied runtime stage. A 0.1 gate floor, ungated world branch and explicit relation skip prevent hard stage decisions from erasing essential dependencies. There is still just one action-generating common DP, not four controllers.
dependencies_preserved: The ungated world encoder sees hand/object/goal relative to wall, wall absolute center, wall half sizes, all three heights, and current/previous object rotation. Fixed world axes retain gravity, gripper orientation and wall asymmetry.

The local branch sees current/native-previous hand/object motion and apertures. Lift additionally sees both wall-top clearances and wall geometry. Carry/settle see both goal errors, coupling, motion, orientation and all wall relations.
Nonzero soft-gate floor preserves every branch at every phase; explicit hand-object, goal-object and goal-hand vectors bypass learned encoders.
Only the explicitly absent object2 is omitted. No time, episode ID, fitted stage cache, simulator contact, success indicator or future state enters inference.

evidence_refs.detail: Only the twenty complete current support episodes are allowed.
Correlated x training cells, runtime history/geometry schema and fixed world action control.
Gripper at tabletop object just before the observed lift action change.
Object lifted on near side of wall.
Carrying beyond the wall toward the goal.
Descent actions through step 27 switch abruptly to world_dz=1 with gripper=0.9 at step 28.
Aperture narrows while the hand approaches the still-tabletop object.
Hand and object rise together with about 0.04 m vertical separation, motivating a separate lift/coupling representation.

Carry motion is primarily forward with maintained height and grip.

expected_failure_signature: A successful factorization would separate accurate grasp from independently directed carry in crossed cells. Its falsifiable weakness is off-demonstration phase ambiguity: a missed grasp, slip, or weak action-change label may make the router emphasize lift or carry prematurely. That should appear as stable phase-like motion without object attachment or premature descent, rather than simply a wrong global x sign. Gate floors mitigate but do not eliminate this risk. No measured performance is asserted.

required_runtime_fields.semantics: Raw shared state only. Both conditioned observations are processed separately by the same encoders and router.

action_frame_semantics: Identity action encode/decode: first three channels remain native world translations at 0.01 m/unit and fourth remains native gripper. No candidate clipping, action override, hard stage controller or planner. Host alone executes the fixed four-action prefix.

training_only_targets.name: stage_onehot
training_only_targets.source: Exact D20 native actions and window (episode,t) indices, used only in training_targets.
training_only_targets.definition: Within each support episode: first dz>0.5 with abs(dy)<0.2 is lift onset; first dy>0.5 at/after lift is carry onset; first dz<-0.1 at/after carry is settling onset. Missing cuts equal T. Label is number of cuts reached at chunk start t. These are weak action-mode labels, not simulator phase truth.
training_only_targets.loss: 0.05 times cross entropy of current causal router probabilities. Per-window labels use mask[:,0] and denominator mask[:,0].sum(), clamped to one for an empty mask. They do not label padded future steps or enter inference. Common action4 epsilon loss remains weight one with denominator mask.sum()*4.

support_statistics: No persistent candidate support statistics. Local action change points exist only while constructing training labels and are never stored in deployment state. Fixed metric feature scales are not fitted.
architecture: Approach 21->64->24, lift 29->64->24, transport and settle independently 36->64->24, ungated world 26->64->24, all SiLU. Router 18->48->4 softmax. Condition is probabilities4 + four gated24 + world24 + relation skip9 =133. All learned modules are registered during build_modules and receive joint-loss gradients.
change_summary: Second initial, substantively independent design: learned factorized condition and training-only weak phase supervision, with native-world actions. No performance feedback used; no pre-check structural edits.
